models.first_review: Full all pinned new/old raw, existing source(s), generated candidate, full diff, all actual fixed query answers and relevant concept context; no size/schema waiver.
models.targeted_retries: Only bounded corrections with unchanged hashes and retained first full proof; otherwise full rereview.
models.delegate_writes: Only assigned external candidates/receipts/reviews; repository read-only; no worktrees. Coordinator alone promotes and writes tracking/aggregate pages.
models.closure: Validate every source/candidate/old/new hash, exact quotes, fullread/independentrole proof, actual query answers, concept/aggregate scope, 3 predetermined full coordinator audits; material partial/fail expands coordinator audit to all selected contributions. No publication without separate approval.
